fusions.name: Roost-Shaking Clap
fusions.desc: Claps once, dealing 26 resonating damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaving each [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Rafter Drop
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and grabs it, dealing 13 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Flutter
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds, and carries you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Latched Thumbs
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
